title: Nothing Happens At Zero
gallery_text: The office rent trend is set to zero and the year scrubber stops working - the district is identical in 2025 and 2050. A sandbox that looks like it is about housing turns out to be about the office market.
description:
One value changed from the defaults: the office rent trend, from a mild decline to flat.

With it, buildings convert progressively across the six dates. Without it, the map is frozen: whatever cleared the deal in 2025 clears it in 2050, and whatever failed keeps failing. The year control is still there and still moves, and it changes nothing at all.

That is worth more than the conversions. The clock in this model is not a clock. It is the office market, wearing a clock's clothes.
